# `MC_knlAlloc`

Allocate a WIPI-managed memory block and return its memory ID.

## Prototype

```c
M_Uint32 MC_knlAlloc(M_Int32 size);
```

```{doxygenfunction} MC_knlAlloc
:project: libwipi
```

## Usage

The return value is a memory ID, not a stable C pointer. Resolve it with MC_GETDPTR only for the period in which the pointer is needed.

### Parameters

| Name | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `size` | Requested allocation size in bytes. |

### Return value

A nonzero memory ID on success, or the provider-defined failure value.

### Ownership

The caller owns the memory ID and releases it with MC_knlFree.

### Notes

- Compaction can invalidate a previously resolved pointer; retain the memory ID instead of the pointer.
